subject: general
question: **‘Along with the flagging population data.’ Here, ‘flagging’ means all of the following** **except**
solution: The correct answer is: **ascending** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "**flagging**" in this context means becoming weak or losing energy. (कमज़ोर होना या ऊर्जा खोना) • **For example**: *His enthusiasm for the project was flagging as time went on.* • **Ascending **means increasing or going up. (आकार या मात्रा में वृद्धि होना) • **For example**: *The hikers were ascending the steep mountain trail with determination.* Therefore, **Option 1** is the exception and does not fit the definition of "flagging". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Waning**: Gradually decreasing or becoming weaker. (धीरे-धीरे कम होना या कमजोर होना) • **Dwindling**: Shrinking or reducing in size, amount, or intensity. (आकार, मात्रा या तीव्रता में सिकुड़न या कमी होना) • **Contracting**: Getting smaller or tighter; entering into a formal agreement. (छोटा या कड़ा होना; एक औपचारिक समझौते में प्रवेश करना) 102:T7fa, The correct answer is: **CADBE**
